name: Generic aerobic respiration (C6H12O6 + 6 O2 -> 6 CO2 + 6 H2O)

provenance.source: Stumm & Morgan, Aquatic Chemistry (3rd ed., 1996), redox-sequence ladder
provenance.ref: aerobic respiration requires the OXIDIZING window Eh ~ +50..+500 mV (O2/H2O couple, circumneutral oxic water); disjoint from strict-anaerobe methanogenesis (Eh < -200 mV)

notes: CONSOLIDATION component #2 (stopping-rule test): the mirror of photosynthesis, a closed atom-balanced function box using ONLY already-grounded species (glucose, O2, CO2, H2O) with canonical ChEBI ids. It exercises no new transfer type, dimension, facet, or identity mechanism. Together with pritchard_glycolysis (also dry) this is the second consecutive component that surfaces nothing new -> the stopping rule for a schema-v1 freeze is met. Chains with phototroph_generic into a closed carbon cycle.

validity.note: phenomenological; valid where glucose and O2 are the limiting reactants
